About Us

Building Software That Matters Since 2012

Arada Tech is a software development company in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, led by Tinsae Mesfin. Since 2012, our developers, designers, and strategists have partnered with businesses to ship reliable, user-centered digital products.

Our Story

Arada Tech was founded by Tinsae Mesfin in 2012 with a clear vision: Ethiopian businesses deserve access to the same quality of software that powers companies anywhere in the world.

Starting from a small office in Addis Ababa, we grew by earning trust — one successful project at a time. We learned that the key to great software isn't just technical skill, but deeply understanding the business problems we're solving.

Today, we work with businesses across Ethiopia — from healthcare clinics to engineering firms, from startups to established enterprises. What has never changed is our commitment to quality, transparency, and genuine partnership with every client.

Our Values

What Guides Every Decision We Make

Quality Over Quantity

We take on fewer projects to give each one the attention it deserves. Every product we deliver reflects our highest standards.

Radical Transparency

No black boxes. You see every milestone, every decision, every line of progress. Your project, your visibility.

Long-Term Partnerships

We build relationships, not just software. Over 80% of our clients have been with us for multiple projects over years.

Continuous Improvement

Technology evolves fast. We invest in learning, adopt modern practices, and bring the latest proven solutions to every project.
